title: Dev M and RC2 AAPS Client missing BG's and regular updates
symptom: AAPSClient misses BG updates and regular updates, even with all power savings off. Updates can be obtained by pausing websockets and restarting, while NSClient receives regular updates.
fix: Improved in a commit (b870de1e078696a842b934287edf09c7754b313d), but the issue persists for BG updates.
